name: Assembling Yourselves Together
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of believers gathering together regularly, as Hebrews 10:25 instructs not to neglect assembling but to encourage one another, especially as the day of Christ's return draws near. This communal worship is to be conducted in spirit and truth, reflecting the nature of God Himself as revealed in John 4:24. Furthermore, assembling serves a practical purpose in fostering love and good works among believers, motivating each other toward Christlike living as described in Hebrews 10:24.
